name: 28173 · Waxhaw, NC
findings: ZIP 28173 (Waxhaw) has 210 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28173 (Waxhaw) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28173 (Waxhaw) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
